errors.description: Raised when an event is requested by an event ID that does not exist in the system.
errors.name: EventNotFoundError

errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to register for an event that has reached its maximum capacity.
errors.name: RegistrationCapacityExceededError

errors.description: Raised when a registration record is attempted to be created without a valid event_id that exists in the system.
errors.name: RegistrationEventIdNotFoundError

errors.description: Raised when a registration record is attempted to be created without a valid user_id that exists in the system.
errors.name: RegistrationUserIdNotFoundError
